iac-mount-screw-estimated.summary: Two diagonal screws clamp the valve and separate gasket to the throttle pad.

steps.title: Follow the clamping stack
steps.text: Each modeled head bears on a flange ear; its shank passes through the body and gasket into a blind receiver.

troubleshooting.title: Missing contact or blocked passage
troubleshooting.text: The isolated checker rejects a lifted head, oversized shank and blocked bypass. Smooth thread envelopes do not establish tightening strength.

iac-mount-screw-estimated.limits: Educational fit study. Valve variant, dimensions, threads, spring construction/rate/preload, joint strength and end-plug sealing remain unresolved; no factory calibration or leak-tightness is certified.

iac-return-spring-estimated.summary: This illustrative spring supplies a visible restoring path between the chamber closure and pintle.

steps.title: A construction choice
steps.text: The spring and idealized closed ends are estimated. Three geometric trial positions remain seated; they are not calibrated valve travel or a force simulation.

iac-armature.summary: The armature acts through a stem joint on the reverse-seated pintle.

steps.title: Keep the joint connected
steps.text: An estimated contact sleeve removes the inherited radial gap. The manual supports direct linkage; actual joint construction and retention strength remain unknown.

iac-gasket.summary: A separate two-port gasket joins the IAC valve to the throttle pad.

steps.title: Leave both bypass openings clear
steps.text: The candidate retains the original bypass openings and adds diagonal fastener clearances. This geometry check does not prove material sealing performance.

iac-valve-body.summary: The body carries two bypass chambers, a reverse-pintle seat and two estimated attachment ears.

steps.title: Separate evidence from estimate
steps.text: Exact1994 service diagrams show two bolts and a separate gasket. Casting contour, flange dimensions and installed valve variant remain provisional.
